g1.label: 1. When does the scheme start?
g1.why: The recording says the new recycling scheme starts next Monday.

g2.label: 2. What goes in blue bins?
g2.why: The recording says blue bins are for paper and cardboard only.

g3.label: 3. What should students do first?
g3.why: The recording says to rinse containers before recycling them.

g4.label: 4. Why does rinsing matter?
g4.why: The recording says dirty items can contaminate a whole bin of good recycling.

g5.label: 5. What does the cleanest class win?
g5.why: The recording says the class with the cleanest recycling each month wins a prize.

g6.label: 6. Where does a greasy pizza box go?
g6.why: The dialogue says a greasy pizza box should go in the food waste bin.

g7.label: 7. Where does a water bottle go?
g7.why: The dialogue says an empty water bottle goes in the green bin, rinsed first.

g8.label: 8. What does Nora want?
g8.why: The dialogue says Nora wants their class to win the monthly prize.

g1.label: 1. Mia — drawing, colourful designs
g1.why: The text says the Poster Designer creates posters and signs for the bins.

g2.label: 2. Ben — checking details, records
g2.why: The text says the Bin Monitor checks bins and records which classes are doing well.

g3.label: 3. Zara — social media, photos
g3.why: The text says the Social Media Officer posts updates and eco-tips online.

g4.label: 4. Tomas — gardening, growing plants
g4.why: The text says the Compost Manager looks after the compost bin.

g5.label: 5. Cardboard allowed in blue bins
g5.why: The text says blue bins are only for paper, not cardboard.

g6.label: 6. Bins checked every Friday
g6.why: The text confirms the Green Team checks bins every Friday.

g7.label: 7. Only cleanest class can win
g7.why: The text says any class can win the monthly prize, not just the cleanest one.

g8.label: 8. Food waste in brown bins
g8.why: The text confirms food waste should go in the brown bins in the canteen.
